questions.alcohol: Is alcohol, drinking, or the presentation of alcoholic beverages a main subject? Exclude disinfectants and small amounts used only in cooking.
questions.real_violence: Does the image show real-world physical violence, blood, or injuries? Exclude game imagery and metaphors.
questions.game_combat: Does the image show shooting, fighting, or attacks using weapons within a video game?
questions.sexual_content: Is sexual depiction, sexual activity, or sex education a main subject? Exclude ordinary romance alone.
questions.news_context: Is the subject presented as news reporting?
questions.educational_context: Is the subject presented as educational, medical, or preventive information?
questions.food: Is food, cooking, or a cooking procedure a main subject?
questions.sports: Is a sporting competition, practice, or spectatorship a main subject?
